text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship is set to face off against
Eishin
Flash in
the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only the best of the best gather for this
Grand Prix race. One cannot even hope
to seize victory
without training hard for
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I psyche myself up as I head for the
trainer's office, only to be distracted by
the sound of
laughter in an
all-too-familiar voice.
choice_data_list: (Today's the day I give it my all....
(Today's the day we give it our al...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh-hohoho!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The essential element to being the best

Umamusume of all is simple. And that is:

overwhelming beauty!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Why, with my incomparable loveliness,

dominating Paris Fashion Week would
be but a
trifle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh-hohoho! Ohhh-hohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I race after Gold Ship with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Beauty! Beauty! Beauty!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Beaaauuuty!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There, now that's what I call aesthetics!
I'll have
the whole world ensnared in no
ti―
What lofty dreams you have.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whozzat?

However, it would behoove you to save
the
"ensnaring the world" talk until you
can best me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, 'tis I! The living embodiment of
beauty!
The chosen child graced with
heavenly light!
None other than T―

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Guh! How dare you rob me of my grand

introduction!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems it would also behoove me not to

underestimate you, Golshi.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Let us settle this matter once
and for
all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Today we shall establish whose beauty is
superior,
and upon whom the matron
goddess of our art
most favorably smiles!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sounds great! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Get ready to be awed by the power of
my
sandpaper-polished beauty!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, get over here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You be the judge of this beauty contest.
And
you'd better cast your vote fairly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Gold Ship's... very firm
suggestion, I
find myself serving as
arbiter of their battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so it begins...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, let's see you try to act out this! A weeping willow dancing in the breeze atop a hill!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fssshhh... Well?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Th-that wasn't half bad!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, allow me to issue your challenge.
White
feathers dancing down from the
heavens!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Fwahhh... What do you think?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Perfect, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm just getting started. I'm only
using a
quarter of my strength right now!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! As am I! Now, what is my next
challenge?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A largish clam!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A lonely rose blooming in twilight!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A stalk of seaweed living in the modern
world!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A flash of azure lightning from beyond
the clouds!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The heated battle carries on...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we've been at it for four hours...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Yet no clear victor has
emerged...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Loath as I am to admit it, it seems I have
no
choice but to acknowledge your
prowess.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship and T.M. O...
text_block_list.text:
Your power level is a match for mine!
You are a
worthy opponent!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we should do this again sometime!
Then we
can settle this once and for all!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't have it any other way! Victory
shall be
mine in our next battle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, their competition ends without
me having
to say a word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship vs. T.M. Opera O: draw! (To
be
continued...)
